title: OpenAI Daybreak security communication linked to GPT-5.5-Cyber
summary: On 2026-06-23, the GPT-5.5-Cyber thread linked to an official OpenAI Daybreak page. Based on the dated official link and its security-oriented URL, this is proposed as a material public communication in the project's development history. Its detailed claims and precise technical significance have not been researched.
